Title: Consultant Associate – Recent Graduate
Description: We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential. We are looking for proactive engineers with a strong desire to learn, a problem-solving mindset, and a clear customer-first attitude. As part of a global Siemens organization , you will work closely with international teams to support and continuously improve Siemens Digital Industries Software solutions, playing a key role in ensuring stability, performance, and customer satisfaction across our application landscape. Depending on the area of the team you join, your responsibilities may include supporting the operation, maintenance, and incident resolution of Siemens software solutions in the cloud, or contributing to the development of customer-specific customizations and enhancements . Our primary focus areas include Teamcenter and Opcenter , and you will be exposed to real-world production environments, global customers, and collaborative, follow-the-sun operations—making this role an excellent opportunity to grow both technically and professionally within a high-performing global team. Requirements Flexibility in work schedules, including availability to provide weekend support. High level of written and spoken English. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. Availability to work on-site during the initial training period. Location Candidates must be based in Mexico City or Monterrey Experience Maximum of 1.5 year of professional experience is preferred. Previous experience in application support or a similar role is highly desirable. Technical Skills Strong Software development background in Python, C and C++, HTML5, CSS2, modern JavaScript (NodeJS/NPM), ReactJS Experience with databases and query languages (SQL) Familiarity with CyberArk and VirtualBox (Nice to have) Work Model Initial 3-month on-site training in the Mexico City or Monterrey office. After successful completion of training and based on performance, the role will transition to a hybrid work model , with up to 3 days per week of home office . Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #SWSaaS

Diseñar y desplegar el plan de administración del cambio (comunicación, capacitaciones) que permita la adopción de proyectos de tecnología y datos, garantizando la captura de beneficios. Fomentar y representar el cambio cultural en la organización como embajadores del proceso de analíticos en arca continental. Title: Business Intelligence Leader–Commercial Operations for ELECTRIFICATION

Market analysis Prepares analyses of internal sales, technical and financial data, and external market data. Interprets resulting data and makes recommendations to leadership in preparation for marketing and sales monthly/quarterly updates. Build a robust sales performance analysis system regarding channels, segments, geographic areas, customers, products and services. If you are interested in learning about Commercial Operations and OTR processes and engage in active communication of insights and analysis for decision making in a fast-paced Distribution & OEM operation.
